name: stable-diffusion.cpp
//: Same packaging rule as llama.cpp: one build per machine type, Vulkan plus the full CPU backend set in a single package, so it runs with or without a GPU. Invoked per-image via sd-cli — the model loads, generates, and exits, so it holds no memory between generations and can never linger next to the LLM.
